Title: LR2 - ED-330 - Authority-validated maintenance procedures (Class 3)
Text: Maintenance instructions to ensure safe operation of a Class 3 (ARC B,C and SAIL V, VI) DAA for VLL shall be defined and made available to the UAS operator. The maintenance procedures manual is validated by a competent authority. Notefrom EASA MOC to OSO#3 SAIL III.
